spans.s:
कृश् कृ॑श्यति pp. कृशित become or be lean or feeble. C.
कर्शयति, pp. कर्शित (often confounded with the C. of कृष्) make
lean, keep short of food, diminish, attenuate, vex, torment. - अनु,
अव, प्रि, वि afflict, vex.
2 कृशन m. the pulsing of the heart.
कृशाङ्ग f. ई lean (membered), thin, slender.
कृशी@कृ & भू make or become thin, weak, or poor.

कृषक m. ploughman, husbandman;
 f. कृषिका agriculture.
कृषिजीविन् m. the same (lit. living by agriculture).
कृष्टज a. grown on tilled ground.

कृष्टि॑ f. (lit. drawing, ploughing) pl. the (ploughing)
people, the races of men (supposed to be 5).

कृष्णचतुर्दशी f. the fourteenth day of the dark
half of the month, i.e. new moon's day.

कृष्णजन्माष्टमी f. the eighth (of a cert. month,
thought as) Kṛṣṇa's birth-day.

कृष्ण॑ल (m.) n. a kind of black berry (used as a weight
or a coin).
कृष्णवर्त्मन् m. fire (lit. having a black way).
कृष्णसर्प m. a very venomous black serpent.
कृष्णाजिन॑ n. the skin of the black antelope.

कृष्णाय् कृष्णा˚यति behave like Kṛṣṇa, ˚यते make
black.
कृसर m. n., आ f., a dish of rice and sesamum.
